Legendary playback singer Hariharan sits down with The Hindu to celebrate a remarkable milestone: 50 years in the music industry. Spanning over 15,000 songs across 10 languages and 30 ghazal albums, Hariharan discusses his musical journey, his roots bridging Mumbai and Chennai, training under legendary masters, recording with Kishore Kumar, the record-breaking success of his Hanuman Chalisa rendition, and his profound concerns regarding the “AI dilemma” in modern music.
